ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a vertical infinitely long straight wire on the left carrying current I1 upward. To its right, in the same plane, there is an equilateral triangular current loop labeled I2. The triangle has a vertical side nearest the straight wire and a pointed vertex to the right. The current on the triangle's near vertical side is upward; along the two slanted sides it circulates through the right-hand vertex. Reasoning: At the position of the triangular loop, which is to the right of an upward current in the long straight wire, the magnetic field produced by the straight wire points into the page. Using the magnetic force law dF = I dℓ × B: on the near vertical side, the loop current is upward, parallel to the long-wire current, so this side is attracted leftward toward the straight wire. On the two slanted sides, the forces have vertical components that cancel by symmetry, while their horizontal components point to the right, away from the straight wire. However, those slanted sides are farther from the straight wire over most of their length, so they experience a weaker magnetic field than the near vertical side. The leftward attraction on the nearest vertical side therefore dominates the rightward components from the slanted sides. Hence the net force on the triangular loop is toward the long straight wire.

method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是一根竖直的无限长直导线，电流 I1 的箭头向上。右侧是一个与直导线共面的等边三角形载流线圈，三角形的尖端朝右，靠近直导线的一边是竖直边。线圈上的电流箭头显示：左侧竖直边电流向上，上斜边电流向右下方，下斜边电流向左下方，因此整个三角形线圈电流方向为顺时针。

再推理：顺时针电流线圈按右手定则，其磁矩方向垂直纸面向里。左侧长直导线电流向上，根据右手定则，在导线右侧区域的磁场方向也垂直纸面向里。因此三角形线圈的磁矩与长直导线在其位置产生的外磁场同向。长直导线磁场大小 B = μ0 I1/(2πr)，离导线越近磁场越强，离导线越远磁场越弱。磁矩与磁场同向时，系统倾向于进入更强磁场区域以降低能量，所以线圈受到指向强磁场区域的合力。强磁场区域在左侧、靠近长直导线处，因此三角形载流线圈将整体向左平移，即朝长直导线运动。
